description: Scan the customer's sitemap (nested indexes handled) or crawl a blog root page and return same-site page URLs, minus the articles RankControl published (those are linked already). The source is remembered and re-read daily. Costly (3/min); review the URLs, then call add_site_pages with the keepers.

source.description: sitemap reads a sitemap XML. blogroot collects the links on one page, like your blog index.

url.description: Sitemap XML URL or a page URL to crawl

name: detect_site_links
